title: The Final Exam, and It's a Game
description: No new ideas in this lesson — just everything from Module 2 onward, tested the way this whole course has always taught: by doing, not reciting.

content.value: Every part you can name on ARIA right now, you learned the reason for somewhere in this course: why the battery sits low and central, why the caster is a ball instead of a wheel, why the sensors point where they point. This lesson asks you to prove it, live, on the bench.

content.title: 🔧 One last look before the exam
content.hint: Spin her, explode her, x-ray her — however you study best.

content.value: Same format as Module 2's Part Hunt, with everything this course has since taught folded in — sensors, motors, the brain, the movement system, all fair game. Wrong guesses still teach: a mis-click shakes and names whatever you actually hit.

There's no hint button in this final round, on purpose. If a part's name has genuinely slipped your mind, that's useful information — it tells you exactly which earlier module is worth a quick re-read before the debug lab next.
Key takeaway: naming and locating every part on ARIA, quickly and confidently, is the real test of whether this course's twelve modules actually stuck — not a definitions quiz, a hands-on one.

quiz.question: Why does this lesson's assessment take the form of a game (Part Hunt) rather than a written quiz?
options: Games are always easier than quizzes
It matches how the whole course has taught throughout — by doing and interacting, not reciting definitions
Written quizzes aren't possible in this format
quiz.explain: Every module in this course has favoured hands-on interaction over recitation — the final assessment stays consistent with that.

quiz.question: Why is it useful, not just embarrassing, if you can't immediately name a part during Part Hunt?
options: It tells you exactly which module's content is worth revisiting before moving on
Part Hunt doesn't actually test anything real
quiz.explain: A wrong or missed answer is diagnostic information — it points precisely at what to review, which is the whole spirit of this course's approach to mistakes.
